architectureDecisions: Reuse standalone GEPA 0.1.4 at source commit d771eb21b5dd3228bc3f567293d2ccfc423fc900 as offline optimizer only; product feedback capture and resolution do not depend on Python or GEPA availability.
Keep the product package optimizer-agnostic. Feedback contracts/controller/projection/improvement envelope live in packages/agentic-system; the GEPA Node/Python bridge lives under scripts/feedback.

Direct worker dependencies are the reusable contract owners BB-059 (HOW evaluation/promotion), BB-064 (Oracle ContextResolution/currentness) and BB-065 (@exharness/benchmark). BB-075 is research evidence for fixed-factor held-out policy, not a direct runtime dependency.

At Worker start, resolve exact DONE implementation-result/judgment/Living refs and public exports for every direct dependency. Planned contract mismatch or missing delivery is PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION before source writes.

Node owns benchmark registration, AttemptLedger reservation, side effects, reconciliation, cancellation accounting and evidence refs. Python owns only GEPA optimizer computation over a bounded JSON-lines callback protocol.

GEPA search acceptance is never product acceptance. The selected candidate becomes HOW_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL_V1 with no accepted/promoted flag and crosses independent BB-059 evaluation/currentness authority.

Omit LangMem from v1. Deterministic native episode/cohort projection is the only required pattern memory; an LLM or future LangMem adapter may produce untrusted proposals only after separate labeled-cohort evidence.

Freeze development/search-validation/final-holdout separation. Final holdout is inaccessible to GEPA/reflection; deterministic cases run once and stochastic model-backed cases use at least three paired repeats unless a frozen metric policy requires more.
The exact metric-policy ref+digest and minEffect are fixed before candidate search. Missing required measurements remain INCONCLUSIVE; no universal percentage is invented by BB-083.

Use only GEPA base-package API with Python >=3.10,<3.15; no gepa[full], DSPy, LangChain or LangMem dependency. Trusted local GEPA pickle checkpoint state is recovery-only and never canonical acceptance evidence.
implementationSlices: S1 — Dependency convergence: before writes, resolve exact DONE BB-059/BB-064/BB-065 implementation-result, judgment and Living refs plus the public HOW/Oracle/benchmark exports. Emit one dependency manifest for tests; any missing/incompatible contract exits PLAN_INPUT_CONTRADICTION.

S2 — Typed lifecycle contracts: implement immutable Observation, ContextBinding, FeedbackEpisode, FeedbackResponse, FeedbackOutcome and HOW_IMPROVEMENT_PROPOSAL_V1 validators with exact ref+digest identity, explicit uncertainty and no implicit authority.

S3 — Observation/context projection: normalize delivered observation/event evidence, bind exact Oracle ContextResolution/currentness/provenance, reject missing/stale/ambiguous context as unresolved, and never infer causal truth from provider prose.

S4 — Application-owned response lifecycle: implement ACTED/REJECTED/DEFERRED/SUPERSEDED disposition with expected-current revision, idempotent recovery and fresh IMPROVED/NO_CHANGE/REGRESSED/UNKNOWN outcome binding. Observer/evaluator/provider fields cannot supply the application principal.

S5 — Cross-episode projection and reinforcement: deterministically deduplicate episode refs, group only on explicit cohort keys, retain contrary evidence, require mechanism evidence for SYSTEMIC proposals, and treat positive reinforcement as evidence rather than automatic escalation.

S6 — Offline GEPA bridge: implement Node-owned bidirectional JSON-lines orchestration to pinned Python GEPA; reserve @exharness/benchmark attempts before callbacks, reopen/reconcile exact settled/uncertain attempts across crash, preserve cancellation reservations, enforce hard budget before dispatch and normalize only a proposal envelope.

S7 — Independent improvement handoff: freeze HOW subject, optimizer identity, partitions, metric-policy ref+digest/minEffect and final holdout before candidate search; register final baseline/candidate work in @exharness/benchmark and submit proposal/evidence to delivered BB-059 evaluation/promotion authority. GEPA never sees final holdout or publishes policy.

S8 — Verification and Living truth: run contract/controller/projection/improvement/bridge/dependency negatives plus agentic and repository regressions; document only delivered feedback capability and explicit optimizer/evaluation limitations in the new Living feedback doc.

feedbackContract.authority: Observation/finding/evaluator/optimizer are evidence or proposal producers only; application principal owns disposition and BB-059 independent authority owns promotion.
feedbackContract.unknownRule: Missing current context, required measurement or independent evidence remains unresolved/UNKNOWN and cannot be converted to success.

patternContract.identity: Pattern key = explicit scope/cohort key + normalized finding kind + target HOW axis; contributing episode refs are deduplicated by immutable episode identity.
patternContract.reinforcement: Repeated positive evidence increases support metadata only; it does not change response status, SYSTEMIC classification, acceptance or promotion.
patternContract.systemic: SYSTEMIC proposal requires explicit mechanism evidence refs spanning the declared scope plus contrary-evidence accounting; frequency alone is insufficient.
patternContract.synthesis: Optional model synthesis is untrusted text attached to exact episode refs. Native deterministic projection remains canonical v1 behavior.
patternContract.langMem: OMITTED_V1; reconsider only through separate labeled-cohort evidence showing material extraction benefit under the same cost/evidence contract.

optimizerContract.location: offline scripts/feedback tooling; ordinary feedback lifecycle has no Python/GEPA runtime dependency
optimizerContract.lock: scripts/feedback/requirements.lock records exact VCS commit and Python range; any change creates a new optimizer identity.
optimizerContract.checkpoint: Only same-run trusted local GEPA checkpoint directories may be loaded; upstream pickle state is never accepted as ExHarness truth.

bridgeContract.transport: bounded bidirectional JSON-lines over one Node-owned child process per optimization run; request ids and schema kinds are explicit
bridgeContract.pythonRole: GEPA optimizer computation; evaluation callbacks contain no direct repository/product/benchmark mutation capability
bridgeContract.admission: Node reserves each delivered @exharness/benchmark attempt before evaluation dispatch. Denied reservation is returned to Python as a terminal budget result without side effect.
bridgeContract.crash: Settled attempts reopen by exact evidence refs; uncertain side effects reconcile before reuse; Python restart/checkpoint cannot blindly redispatch an unknown attempt.
bridgeContract.cancellation: Killing optimizer does not refund started reservations or rewrite settled attempts. In-flight unknown attempts remain auditable/reconcilable.
bridgeContract.accounting: Unknown usage/cost remains null/UNKNOWN; reflection/search/final-evaluation calls are attributed to their exact experiment/unit/attempt.

evaluationHandoffContract.owner: delivered BB-059 independent HOW evaluation/promotion authority
fixedBeforeSearch: optimizer engine/version/commit/config and allowed HOW axis
evaluationHandoffContract.partitionRule: Final holdout is inaccessible to GEPA, reflection memory and candidate producer; any leakage invalidates the evaluation.
evaluationHandoffContract.repeatRule: Deterministic cases may run once; stochastic model-backed cases require at least three paired baseline/candidate repeats per case unless the frozen metric policy requires more.
evaluationHandoffContract.benchmarkRule: Every final baseline/candidate run is registered through @exharness/benchmark with append-only attempts, evidence manifest, nullable accounting and audit reopening.
evaluationHandoffContract.decisionRule: Per-case critical quality/authority/currentness/recovery regression blocks promotion regardless of aggregate score; missing required evidence is INCONCLUSIVE.
evaluationHandoffContract.thresholdRule: BB-083 does not invent a universal numeric effect. The exact metric-policy minEffect is mandatory and immutable before candidate search.

deliveryContract.forbidden: No modification of dependency owners, no generic memory/workflow platform, no self-promotion, no final-holdout exposure to optimizer, no unknown-as-success.
